first_missing_criterion: Official Historic England Listed Building polygons FeatureServer record for ListEntry 1306502 (Bridge Inn, Topsham, Exeter), with returned record-level Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates bound to ListEntry/Name/Grade and the official NHLE type/use evidence. The official layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer supporting GeoJSON and exposes ListEntry, Name, Grade and area_ha fields; the official NHLE record identifies Bridge Inn as a Grade II C18 coaching inn/public house and records a 7 June 2022 amendment. The distinct exact-record GeoJSON query could not be retrieved through the web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload was read; no footprint geometry was inferred or fabricated.
